sources.title: Best Aphelios Build Guides 2026 for LoL Patch 26.17
Aphelios Build Guide: The (Detailed) Beginner's Guide

passive.name: The Hitman and the Seer
passive.text: Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Basic Attack and Ability. Attacks and abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next of the 5.

spells.name: Weapon Abilites
spells.text: Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon:Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons.Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon.Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon.Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.

spells.name: Phase
spells.text: Aphelios swaps his main-hand gun with his off-hand gun, replacing his basic attack and activated ability.

spells.name: Weapon Queue System
spells.text: Aphelios has no third ability. This slot shows the next weapon Alune will give him. Weapon order begins fixed but may change over game time -- when a weapon is out of ammo it goes to the end of the order.

spells.name: Moonlight Vigil
spells.text: Fire a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes on enemy champions. Applies the unique effect of Aphelios' main-hand gun.

damage.value: Aphelios deals sustained damage with repeated strikes and Chakram, while Infernum adds area damage.

archetype.value: Aphelios plays as an ADC with a Crescendum attack-speed melee cycle.

axis.value: Aphelios can push the lane with Infernum wave clear.

winCondition.value: Aphelios can damage multiple targets with Infernum, reposition with Severum’s Q, and use Severum for healing when needed.

spikes.at: Aphelios uses Moonlight Vigil with Crescendum
spikes.why: Aphelios gains extra Chakram, significantly increasing his damage at the start of a fight.
Aphelios can fire a blast that explodes on enemy champions and applies his main-hand weapon’s unique effect.

bait.why: After Aphelios uses a weapon ability, its 9-second cooldown leaves that ability unavailable.

mistakes.value: Aphelios loses value by delaying Crescendum Moonlight Vigil when committing to a Chakram blade storm.
Aphelios should not assume one weapon cycle is always optimal, because weapon combinations vary with item thresholds and game state.
